verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a public REST API at developers.heygen.com with API-key onboarding, scoped restricted keys, and concrete endpoints such as POST /v3/models/videos, video creation, and Video Agent revision. It also offers batch calls with webhooks, typed schemas, a CLI, and an official MCP server, and a probe confirmed the developer llms.txt is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all standard probe paths returned 404).
